Sign catalogue

Sign

M343

Looks like: jar with two outward handles and one short stroke in the mouth

Adapted from the field-cady sign descriptions (Parpola 325). This describes the picture, not the meaning: a sign that looks like a fish may stand for a sound or another word.

Wells W741 · Medial

Appears in 162 texts (177 uses), mostly on seals at Mohenjo-daro; usually sits inside a text. In the larger ICIT corpus its Wells equivalent W741 is in 198 texts, including at Dholavira.

Where it appears 162

Counts are distinct texts in the Mahadevan 1977 concordance (a text repeated on many moulded tablets counts once). 175 objects in all carry it.
